## Review

**7 out of 10, Effective.** Presentation quality, judged with the SlideDeck Co review heuristic (https://slidedeck.co/review-methodology/). The ask, the evidence and the merit of the idea are not rated.

The deck has a clear, consistent system: dark blue template, cyan headings, large key numbers, and a headline claim set on slide 2 that later sections repeat and support. Readable slides such as 2, 8 and 22 have a clear subject, strong hierarchy and tidy alignment, and the TCO table on slide 22 is easy to scan with the savings percentages picked out in green. Weaknesses are consequential: slides 4, 5, 10 and 12 pack in tiny labels, several benchmark charts (slides 18, 20, 24, 26) have axis labels too small to read, and about 30 backup slides are walls of microtext. The long middle also repeats the same summary slide several times, and slide 2 shows only bare multipliers with footnote-level comparison baselines.

**Worth keeping:** Keep the large cyan stat callouts and the side-by-side table layout of slide 22, plus the consistent template that makes the deck feel unified.

**Most useful repair:** Cut the small labels on the platform diagram slides and the rotated axis labels on the benchmark charts down to what the audience can read, and make each benchmark chart carry one stated takeaway.

**What would change the score:** I would remove the repeated summary slides and split or trim the backup configuration pages so the main route is shorter and each page earns its place.

_Confidence medium. 69 of 69 pages inspected on contact sheets, 4 at readable size. Reviewed Reviewed 2026-11-08. Model-assisted review (claude-sonnet-5-5)._

## Summary

This sales deck introduces the 4th Gen Intel Xeon Scalable processors and the Intel Xeon CPU Max Series. It opens with a headline slide of performance claims across general compute, AI, 5G vRAN, data analytics, HPC, and networking and storage, then repeats that summary with power and emissions figures. The middle sections cover the platform in detail: architecture and die packaging, memory and interconnect specifications, the built-in accelerators (AMX, DSA, IAA, DLB, QAT), and the security features. Later sections present workload benchmarks against the 3rd Gen parts, a fleet-level total cost of ownership comparison, a high-bandwidth-memory section, and customer quotes. The deck closes with a summary of its claims, a product comparison table, and extensive benchmark configuration notes in the backup. Most slides are dense with footnoted test results, and the layout relies on bar charts and tables. Slides worth studying are the opening overview, the die-package comparison, the accelerator benefit slides, and the TCO table, which lays out assumptions side by side.

## Questions about this deck

**What performance gain does the Intel deck report for general purpose compute?**

Slide 2 reports a 53% average performance gain for general purpose compute, comparing 4th Gen Intel Xeon Scalable processors with 3rd Gen Intel Xeon Scalable processors. Slide 19 repeats the same 53% figure.

**How many slides does the Intel 4th Gen Xeon Scalable presentation deck have?**

The Intel deck has 69 pages in total. Slide 1 is the title slide, headed Accelerate with Xeon and dated January 10.

**What total cost of ownership savings does the Intel deck show for the HPC scenario?**

Slide 22 shows a 66% lower TCO for HPC (OpenFOAM), with 16 servers with Intel Xeon CPU Max Series, 25.7 kW of fleet power, and $1.5M in TCO savings. The slide notes that these figures are estimated over 4 years.

**Which built-in accelerators does the Intel deck list for its 4th Gen Xeon Scalable processors?**

Slide 4 lists the Intel In-Memory Analytics Accelerator (Intel IAA), Intel Data Streaming Accelerator (Intel DSA), Intel Dynamic Load Balancer (Intel DLB), and Intel QuickAssist Technology (Intel QAT). It also lists Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX) among the integrated ISA accelerators.

### Slide 4

**Review notes**

- Review: Weaknesses are consequential: slides 4, 5, 10 and 12 pack in tiny labels, several benchmark charts (slides 18, 20, 24, 26) have axis labels too small to read, and about 30 backup slides are walls of microtext.

**Text**

Intel's Most Feature Rich Server Platform / 4th Gen Intel® Xeon® Scalable Processors and Intel® Xeon® CPU Max Series Processors / New Integrated IP Accelerators / Increased I/O Bandwidth with PCIe 5.0 / Compute Express Link (CXL) 1.1 / 4th Gen Intel Xeon Scalable Processor Intel Xeon CPU Max Series / Intel® In-Memory Analytics Accelerator (Intel® IAA) / Intel® Data Streaming Accelerator (Intel® DSA) / Intel® Dynamic Load Balancer (Intel® DLB) / Intel® QuickAssist Technology (Intel® QAT) / PCIe 5.0/4.0 Up to 80 Lanes / 1 to 8 Socket Support / Intel® In-field Scan ** / Intel® Seamless Firmware Update / High Bandwidth Memory Support / intel XEON / 8 DMI 4.0 LINKS / Intel® C741 Chipset / Intel® Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX) / Accelerating Interfacing Architecture (AiA) / Intel® Advanced Vector Extensions for vRAN / Enhanced Intel® Software Guard Extensions / 8 Channel DDR5 / Up To 4800 MT/s (1DPC) / Up To 4400 MT/s (2DPC) / 16 DIMMS per Socket / New RAS features (Enhanced ECC, Error Check & Scrub) / Intel® Ultra Path Interconnect (Up to 4 Links @ 16 GT/s) / Optimized Power Mode / New Integrated ISA Accelerators / HW-Enhanced Security / Increased Memory Bandwidth with DDR5 / Increased Inter-Socket Bandwidth with UPI 2.0 / Intel® Optane™ Persistent Memory 300 Series / Intel® Agilex™ FPGAs / Intel® Data Center GPU Max Series Intel® Data Center GPU Flex Series / Intel® Infrastructure Processing Unit (Intel® IPU) / intel XEON Accelerate with Xeon / * Enabled for WorkStation + vPro SKUs ONLY / ** Intel In-Filed Scan is a new capability available through select providers in 2023

**Layout**

Three-column layout on a 16:9 slide: a left column of four stacked dark boxes (x about 3 to 20%), a centre technical diagram (x about 21 to 80%) with a chipset and a processor block, and a right column of four stacked dark boxes (x about 79 to 97%). The title sits top-left at about y 6%, with the subtitle directly below it at about y 13%. A full-width blue bar of four labelled product names sits at y about 81.5 to 88.4%. The bottom-left holds the Intel XEON logo and the tagline Accelerate with Xeon; two right-aligned footnotes sit bottom-right. Left margin about 3%, right margin about 2.5%. No slide number is visible.

**Visuals**

Technical block diagram with icons. Centre: a dark navy square processor block (about x 40.8 to 56.3%, y 25.8 to 53.4%) showing the intel logo top-left and a large XEON wordmark, with a cyan glow outline. Below it, a light grey square labelled Intel® C741 Chipset (about x 44.1 to 53.2%, y 58.9 to 75%), connected to the processor by a vertical cyan line labelled 8 DMI 4.0 LINKS. Left column of thin-line cyan icons (about #00C7FD) beside labels: a chip icon for DSA (about x 36.1, y 29.4), a PCIe card icon beside PCIe 5.0/4.0, a network-cube icon for 1 to 8 Socket Support, a gauge icon for In-field Scan, and a memory stick icon for High Bandwidth Memory Support. Right column of cyan icons: a head with gears for AMX, a 5G symbol for AiA/vRAN, a shield with checkmark for Software Guard Extensions, a DIMM module for DDR5, a node network for Ultra Path Interconnect, and a square-outline power symbol for Optimized Power Mode. No photographs.

**Design**

Background: Full-bleed navy gradient image, darker navy #0B1F3A at top-left shading to blue #1B4A8A at bottom-right.

### Slide 5

**Review notes**

- Review: Weaknesses are consequential: slides 4, 5, 10 and 12 pack in tiny labels, several benchmark charts (slides 18, 20, 24, 26) have axis labels too small to read, and about 30 backup slides are walls of microtext.

**Text**

INTRODUCING
4th Gen Intel® Xeon® Scalable Processors
Workload-First Approach to Innovation, Design and
Delivery
Most Built-In Accelerators of any CPU in the Market
with Leading Performance in AI, Analytics,
Networking, Storage, Security, and HPC
Intel’s Most Sustainable Data Center
Processor Ever
In customer hands and delivering real-world results today
intel XEON
Accelerate with Xeon

**Layout**

Full-bleed dark blue slide with a small all-caps eyebrow label and a large title at top left, left-aligned at about 5.3% from the left edge. Three stacked left-aligned text bands sit on the left (x 8.2%) between y 29% and 73%, with the processor photo overlapping the right side of the bands and an Intel XEON tile at lower right. A thin cyan bracket frame surrounds the bands, a full-width-of-banner caption pill sits at y 84.4% spanning x 5.2% to 94.1%, and the Intel XEON wordmark with tagline sits at bottom left. No page number or footer is visible.

**Visuals**

One photograph of a silver Intel Xeon processor module (4th Gen Intel Xeon Scalable Processor) placed at x 59.8%, y 25.9%, 35.7% by 51.9% (671 by 549 px). The module is tilted about 20 degrees clockwise, shown at three-quarter top view on a dark blue background, with brushed silver metal lid, a small gold-edged green circuit substrate along its lower edge, and the printed text intel. XEON, 4th Gen Intel Xeon Scalable Processor on the lid. Lighting is soft and top-lit, making the metal highlights bright and the lid edges grey-white. The photograph is boxed as a rectangle with no crop beyond its edges and no tint. Three dark translucent horizontal bands (approx #071A33 at about 60% opacity) run from the left edge to x 94.9%, at y 25.6% (h 16.1%), y 42.6% (h 16.3%) and y 59.8% (h 16.1%), separated by thin lighter blue gaps approx #1E4D8A. A thin cyan (#00C7FD) bracket outline, 0.2% stroke, runs from the top-left corner at (5.2%, 22.6%) down to (5.2%, 74%) and across the bottom to (89.6%, 77.4%), with a matching vertical line at x 90.4% from y 22.6% to 74.1% and short horizontal segments at the top. A square tile with the intel XEON logo in white and cyan at x 86.5%, y 68.3%, 7.7% by 13.7%, filled with a blue gradient (#1A4D8C to #0B2A55). A horizontal caption pill at x 5.2%, y 84.4%, 88.9% by 5.6%, filled with a dark-to-mid blue gradient (#052B57 to #0A1F40). Bottom-left intel XEON logo: intel in white over XEON in cyan #00C7FD.

**Design**

Background is a diagonal dark navy gradient from about #0A1A36 at top left to #1B4A80 at bottom right. Eyebrow INTRODUCING and body lines are cyan #00C7FD. The title is white with a pale blue tint, approx #F2F8FF to #CFE8FF, rendered as an image. The caption text is white. Typefaces are Intel One Display (Light and Regular) and Intel One Text (Medium), geometric sans-serif. Title is about 7.6% of slide height; body lines are 4.44% of slide height (about 3.3 times smaller than a 7.6% title); eyebrow is 2.60%; caption is 4.44% in medium weight; tagline is 2.96%. Shapes have square corners, no shadows, and thin cyan outlines on the bracket only.

Full-bleed dark slide with a large left-aligned title at top and a light-blue subtitle beneath it, both starting at about x 2% of the width. **Visuals**

One photograph of an Intel 4th Gen Xeon Scalable Processor: a vertical silver metallic CPU package seen straight on, with the intel XEON wordmark in dark grey near its upper third, and the text 4th Gen / Intel Xeon Scalable Processor in dark grey below it. The package fills about 31% of slide width and 73% of slide height, centred horizontally, cut out on the navy background with no box or border, lit by soft even studio light with highlights on the silver lid and a faint shadow. One outlined security box spans the lower centre. Bottom-left Intel XEON logo in white and light blue.

**Design**

Background is a dark navy gradient running from deep navy at top-left to a slightly lighter royal navy at right, roughly #0B1F45 to #1A4A8A. Title is bold white-to-pale-blue, about #FFFFFF with #CFF3FF tint, sans-serif (Intel One Display Bold style), about 6.9% of slide height. Subtitle is light sky blue #00C7FD, light weight, about 4.4% of slide height. Tile text is pale blue #B4F0FF, IntelOneDisplay Light, about 3.3% of slide height, centred. Vertical labels and security heading are accent #00C7FD. Footnotes are grey #BABABA, Intel One Text Regular, about 1.5% of slide height. Tiles are flat dark navy #0A1A3A with about 0.5% gaps and no rounded corners or shadows. Outlines are 1 px #00C7FD. No gradients on tiles.

**Layout**

Full-bleed dark blue slide with a large title at top left (left edge about 4% of width) and a cyan subtitle beneath it. Three equal-width outlined panels sit in a row across the lower two-thirds, each with a centred two-line heading above a die diagram and a centred two-line caption below. The Intel Xeon logo lockup and the tagline 'Accelerate with Xeon' sit at bottom left, about 4% from the left edge. No page number or footer text is visible.

**Visuals**

Three die-package diagrams, each a top-down schematic drawn on a dark navy #002543 square. Left: 4th Gen Intel Xeon XCC (labelled '4 Tile Architecture'), a large die of about 8 columns by 12 rows of tiles. It shows light blue 'CPU Core' cells, lilac/purple 'CHA/SF/LLC' cells, pale pink and grey 'IMC/UPI' strips along the top and bottom edges, a grey vertical mesh strip down the centre, and orange corner blocks labelled as accelerator tiles. Yellow 'MC/IMC/PHY' blocks sit on the left and right edges with yellow arrows pointing outwards. Orange 'Accel' labels with small orange arrows sit at the top and bottom corners of the die, and blue, pink and grey arrows run along the top and bottom edges. Middle: 4th Gen Intel Xeon MCC Monolithic, a smaller single die of about 10 columns by 10 rows with the same colour coding, a yellow 'MC/IMC/PHY' block on each side with yellow arrows, and blue, pink and grey I/O arrows along the top and bottom edges. Right: Intel Xeon CPU Max Series, 4 tile die with the same grid, plus four grey boxes labelled 'HBM' at the top and bottom corners (two rotated 180 degrees at the bottom), with yellow MC/IMC blocks and arrows on both sides. Each diagram is boxed by its dark navy image rectangle, not cropped, and is lit flat with no shadows.

**Design**

Background is a diagonal dark-blue gradient from about #0B1F3A at top-left to #1B4C8A at lower right. Title is white-blue #E6F6FF in a bold geometric sans-serif (Intel One Display Bold), about 8.5% of slide height. Subtitle is bright cyan #00C7FD in Intel One Display Light, about 4.4% of slide height. Panel headings are white #FFFFFF in Intel One Display Light, about 3.0% of slide height. Captions are pale cyan #B4F0FF in Intel One Display Light, about 2.8% of slide height. Accel and HBM labels are orange #F2A072 in Intel One Display Regular, about 2.0% of slide height. Panels have 1 px cyan #00C7FD outlines, square corners, no shadows and dark navy #002543 fills. Die diagrams use orange, yellow #FFFF00, pink, blue, grey and purple accent colours.

Column 2 is titled 4th Gen Intel® Xeon® Scalable Processors and split into Extreme Core Count (XCC) and Medium Core Count (MCC). Column 3 is titled Intel® Xeon® CPU Max Series, labelled High Bandwidth Memory (HBM). Rows, top to bottom: Die Construction (XCC: 4 tiles connected using MDF over Intel Embedded Multi-die Interconnect Bridge (EMIB); MCC: 1 monolithic chip; HBM: 4 tiles connected using MDF over Intel Embedded Multi-die Interconnect Bridge (EMIB)); Core Count (Up to 60 active cores; Up to 32 active cores; Up to 56 active cores); TDP Range (225 to 350W; 125 to 350W; 350W); Memory (XCC and MCC merged: DDR5 @ 4800 (1 DPC), 4400 (2DPC), 16 Gb DRAM, 8 Channels / Intel® Optane™ PMem 300 (Crow Pass) @4400 MT/s; HBM: DDR5 @ 4800 (1 DPC), 4400 (2DPC), 8Channels / 64 GB HBM2e memory with up to 1.14 GB/core); Intel UPI (UPI 2.0 @ 16 GT/s, up to 4 Ultra Path Interconnects; UPI 2.0 @ 16 GT/s, up to 3 Ultra Path Interconnects; UPI 2.0 @ 16 GT/s, up to 4 Ultra Path Interconnects); Scalability (1 Socket, 2 Socket, 4 Socket, 8 Socket; 1 Socket, 2 Socket, 4 Socket; 1 Socket, 2 Socket); PCIe/Compute Express Link (merged across XCC, MCC and HBM: PCIe 5.0 (80 lanes), / Up to 4 devices supported via Compute Express Link (CXL) 1.1); Security (XCC and MCC merged: Intel® SGX / Minimum Enclave Page Cache (EPC) size 256 MB; HBM: Intel® SGX (Flat mode only)); Integrated IP Accelerators (XCC: Intel® QAT, DLB, IAA, DSA (up to 4 devices each); MCC: Intel® QAT, DLB (up to 2 devices each) / Intel ® DSA, IAA ( 1 device each); HBM: Intel® DSA (4 devices)). Cell borders are thin lines in a muted magenta-violet. Header text is cyan; body text is white. Logo: the intel wordmark in white above XEON in cyan, with a small registered mark. No charts or photographs.

**Design**

Background: Dark navy to royal blue diagonal gradient (about #0B1F3A at top-left to #1B4A7A centre to #0E2A4F at bottom-right). Deep navy-to-royal-blue diagonal gradient background, darker at top-left and bottom-right, lighter blue through the centre. Title is pale blue (#CDEBFA) in a large sans-serif (IntelOneDisplay-Medium style), about 7% of slide height. Table headers and tagline accents are cyan #00C7FD. Body text is white #FFFFFF in IntelOneDisplay-Medium, about 2.2% of slide height. Table cells are semi-transparent violet fills (#8F5DA2 at 20% opacity) over the navy, with thin muted magenta-violet cell borders, square corners, and no shadows. Tagline is IntelOneDisplay-Light, about 3% of slide height, white. Layout is clean and flat with no ornamentation.

### Slide 10

**Review notes**

- Review: Weaknesses are consequential: slides 4, 5, 10 and 12 pack in tiny labels, several benchmark charts (slides 18, 20, 24, 26) have axis labels too small to read, and about 30 backup slides are walls of microtext.

**Text**

Driving Platform Innovation
Broad Ecosystem Readiness To Deploy Today
DDR5
▪ 8ch DDR5 (per CPU): up to 4800 MT/s
▪ 9x4 RDIMM support
▪ 3DS RDIMM support
▪ New RAS features
▪ Enhanced ECC
▪ Error Check and Scrub
▪ Both 2DPC and 1DPC today
Up to 1.5x
higher memory bandwidth vs. DDR4
PCIe 5.0
▪ 80 lanes
▪ Improved DDIO and QoS capabilities
▪ X2 bifurcation @ Gen 4
Up to 2x
Increased I/O Bandwidth vs. PCIe 4.0
CXL 1.1
▪ Next Gen I/O
▪ Up to 4 CXL devices supported per CPU

### Slide 12

**Review notes**

- Review: Weaknesses are consequential: slides 4, 5, 10 and 12 pack in tiny labels, several benchmark charts (slides 18, 20, 24, 26) have axis labels too small to read, and about 30 backup slides are walls of microtext.

**Text**

Maximize the Effectiveness of Every Core / New Integrated IP Acceleration Engines / Increase performance, power and cost / efficiency by enabling offload of common / mode tasks via seamlessly integrated / acceleration engines / Native Dispatch, Signaling, and Synchronization from User / Space / Accelerator Interfacing Architecture / Coherent, Shared Memory Space / Between Cores & Acceleration Engines / Concurrently Shareable / Processes, Containers, & VMs / Utilization Without Acceleration / Core / Core / Core / Core / Utilization With Acceleration / Core / Core / Core / Core / Accel. / Accel. / Intel® IAA, QAT, DLB, DSA / *Integrated / Critical Workloads / Common Mode Tasks / Additional Workload Capacity / intel / XEON / Accelerate with Xeon

**Layout**

Two-column composition on a 16:9 slide: the left column (about x 3 to 47%) holds the title block, a bold lead paragraph, and three stacked dark text panels; the right column (about x 51 to 95%) holds two stacked diagrams split by a thin horizontal rule at about y 51%, each with a vertical label box on its left. The title sits top-left at about y 6 to 13% with the subtitle beneath it at about y 14 to 18%, both left-aligned to a margin of about 3.3%. The Intel XEON logo and tagline sit bottom-left at about y 91 to 98%, and the legend runs along the bottom right at about y 91 to 95%. No slide number or footer is visible.

**Visuals**

Two stacked bar-and-core diagrams, not a chart with axes. Top diagram, labelled vertically at left in a dark navy box 'Utilization Without Acceleration': four columns, each a vertical stacked bar (about 4.5% of slide width) sitting on top of a grey Core block. Each bar is a lower grey-to-white gradient segment (Critical Workloads) topped by a blue-to-dark-blue gradient segment (Common Mode Tasks). Column bar heights rise then fall: the first bar's blue top is about 1/3 of the bar, the second bar's grey segment is taller, the third bar's grey segment is lower, and the fourth bar's grey segment reaches about 60% of its height. Thin grey horizontal connector lines run between columns 1 and 2, 2 and 3, and 3 and 4 at mid-height. Below each bar is a square grey metallic Core block (about 4.5% by 8% of slide) with a white inner square labelled 'Core' in dark grey #525252 bold type. Bottom diagram, labelled vertically in a dark navy box 'Utilization With Acceleration': four columns of cyan bars (Additional Workload Capacity, #00C7FD to #0096D6 gradient) on top of grey-to-white Critical Workloads segments, with a thin dark blue line at the cyan/grey junction in columns 2, 3 and 4; column 1 has a larger cyan top, column 2 a short cyan top with a grey segment about 60% tall, column 3 a tall cyan top and small grey base, column 4 a medium cyan top and grey base. Cyan horizontal streak lines run from column 1 to the right edge at about y 57 to 59%, fading to deep blue at the right end. Below the bars are four grey Core blocks labelled 'Core', then two square blue-violet accelerator blocks (#3A4FD6 to #000F8A gradient, light inner squares) labelled 'Accel.' in #000F8A bold type. A curly brace in white hairline sits under the two Accel. blocks with a centred label 'Intel® IAA, QAT, DLB, DSA' and '*Integrated' in italic below it. Legend beneath: a grey-to-white swatch labelled 'Critical Workloads', a blue swatch labelled 'Common Mode Tasks', and a cyan swatch labelled 'Additional Workload Capacity'. Lighting is flat and even with subtle metallic gradients on blocks.

**Design**

Background: Dark navy to royal blue diagonal gradient, #0B1F3A at top-left to #1B4A7A at bottom-right. Full-bleed dark navy gradient background running from deep navy #0B1F3A at top-left to royal blue #1B4A7A at bottom-right. Title in pale ice blue #D9F0FF, bold sans-serif (IntelOne Display Medium/Bold style, close to Helvetica Bold), cap-height about 7% of slide height. Subtitle in bright cyan #00C7FD, light weight sans-serif, about 4.4% of slide height. Bold lead paragraph in white #FFFFFF, medium weight for the bold words and light for the rest, about 4% of slide height. Panel titles in white light sans-serif about 4% of slide height, panel kickers in cyan #00B0F0 light sans-serif about 2.6%. Diagram labels in white light sans-serif about 2.6%. Dark panels are near-black navy #0A1A33 with a subtle left-to-right gradient, separated by thin blue gaps of about 1%; they have square corners, no shadow. Vertical label boxes are dark navy #0B1A30 with a thin cyan #00B0F0 bottom edge line. Horizontal divider is a thin cyan #00B0F0 line fading out at right. Bars have no outline and square corners.

**Layout**

Single-column full-width header with the title top-left at about 6.9% from the top and the subtitle beneath it, both left-aligned to a margin of about 5.5%. A large bordered panel spans the middle from about 25% to 85.6% height and 5.7% to 96.1% width, divided into six equal-looking columns by thin vertical cyan rules, each column holding an icon-and-heading row followed by a bulleted-style text list. The logo lockup and tagline sit bottom-left at about 92% to 98% height, and the copyright note sits bottom-right, right-aligned; there is no slide number.

**Visuals**

Six white line icons sit to the right of the column headings inside the panel: a robot with antenna (AI Engines, about x14.5 y30.2 w2.3 h5.6%), a padlock (Security Engines, about x25.5 y29.6 w1.9 h4.2%), a stacked server rack (HPC Engines, about x44.5 y30.8 w2.1 h4.0%), a hub with three connected nodes (Network Engines, about x54.2 y29.8 w2.8 h4.5%), a bar chart with a gear/spark (Analytics Engines, about x70.4 y30.4 w2.2 h3.8%), and a cylinder database (Storage Engines, about x85.1 y30.0 w2.2 h4.9%). All icons are white, flat, and unboxed. The panel is a dark navy translucent rectangle with a thin pale-blue border, and the five cyan vertical divider lines (about 0.3% wide, 50.2% tall, starting at 30.7%) sit at x 18.6, 33.9, 47.7, 63.2 and 79.2%. No photographs or charts.

**Design**

Background: Diagonal gradient from deep navy #0A1A36 at top-left through cobalt #1C4B86 in the middle to dark navy #0B1E40 at bottom-right, full-bleed. Full-slide diagonal gradient background running from deep navy at the top-left to a lighter cobalt-blue band through the middle and back to dark navy at the bottom-right. Title is white (#FFFFFF) in a geometric sans-serif (Intel One Display Medium, weight medium) at about 6.5% of slide height, with the phrase Accelerator Engines in a pale blue tint (#CFEFFF). Subtitle in Intel One Display Light at about 3.7% of slide height in bright cyan #00C7FD, with the key phrases performance, costs savings and sustainability in Medium weight. Column headings are white Intel One Text Regular at about 3.0% of height; list items are white Intel One Display Regular at about 1.84% of height with no bullet glyphs and generous spacing between items. Divider rules and the copyright line use cyan #00C7FD and grey #BABABA respectively. Panel has square corners, a thin pale-blue outline (about 1px, #8FD8FF), and no shadow. Overall the look is modern, flat and corporate.

**Layout**

Title block is top-left at about 5% from the left and 6% from the top, with the subtitle beneath it. Five equal-width dark cards sit in one row across the slide with about 1.5% gutters, spanning roughly 5% to 95% of the width and from 21% to 81% of the height. A full-width banner bar sits under the cards at 82% to 88% height, with the Intel Xeon logo lockup bottom-left and a small right-aligned footnote bottom-right; there is no slide number.

**Visuals**

Five identical dark rounded-rectangle-free rectangular cards, each with a title, a centered 'Up to' line, a large stat in lilac, and a short description. Card 1: 'Intel® Advanced Matrix Extensions (Intel® AMX)', 8.6x, higher speech recognition inference performance with built-in AMX BF16 vs. FP32. Card 2: 'Intel® Dynamic Load Balancer (Intel® DLB)', 96%, lower latency at the same throughput for Istio-Envoy Ingress with Intel® DLB vs. software for Istio Ingress gateway. Card 3: 'Intel® Data Streaming Accelerator (Intel® DSA)', 1.7x, higher IOPs for SPDK-NVMe with built-in Intel® DSA vs. ISA-L software. Card 4: 'Intel® In-Memory Analytics Accelerator (Intel® IAA)', 2.1x, higher RocksDB performance with Intel® IAA vs Ztsd software. Card 5: 'Intel® QuickAssist Technology (Intel® QAT)', 84%, fewer cores to achieve same connections/s on NGINX with built-in QAT vs. out-of-box software. No photographs or charts. Each card has a faint soft drop shadow and a subtle blue glow beneath it that reaches into the banner area. The banner is a thin translucent dark-navy bar with a slightly lighter top edge. The Intel logo is white lettering with a registered mark, the XEON wordmark is cyan, and the tagline is white.

**Design**

Background: Deep blue diagonal gradient from about #0B1F4A at the top-left to #1C4C8C at the top-right and #0A1A3D at the bottom, full-bleed.

**Layout**

A single full-width horizontal bar chart on a dark slide: the left-aligned title and cyan subtitle sit in the top band from about 7.6% to 18% of the height, and the plot spans about 12.7% to 97.2% of the width with the baseline at 67.9% and the category axis at 83.1% of the height. Five labelled group bands (IAA, AVX-512, DSA, AMX, QAT) sit across the bottom of the bars, category labels are centred under each bar, the intel XEON logo and tagline sit bottom-left, and the grey footnote sits bottom-right on the same line as the tagline; no page number is visible.

**Visuals**

Vertical bar chart of 12 bars, each labelled with its value and category, grouped into five bands. Bars are blue gradient (darker blue #0060B0 at the top, brightening to cyan #00C7FD toward the bottom) with bright cyan #00C7FD lower segments where they pass behind the group bands. Values, left to right: 1.12 (ClickHouse, IAA vs LZ4); 1.26 (ClickHouse, IAA vs ZSTD); 2.01 (RocksDB, IAA vs ZSTD); 1.61 (HPL Linpack, AVX-512 vs AVX2); 3.18 (SPDK 128K QD64 large media files vs OOB); 1.92 (SPDK 16K QD256 database requests vs OOB); 8 (Real Time Image Recognition, AMX vs FP32, RN50); 9.76 (Batch Image Recog, AMX vs FP32, RN50); 14.21 (Real Time Object Detection, AMX vs FP32, SSD-RN34); 13.53 (Batch Object Detection, AMX vs FP32, SSD-RN34); 1.22 (NGINX 65K cps Perf, QAT vs OOB); 28.85 (QATzip, QAT vs zlib/OOB). Axis: no numeric scale is printed; the vertical axis is described only as Relative Perf/W, Higher is Better, with the horizontal white reference line labelled Baseline is 4th Gen Intel Xeon processor with No Acceleration at 67.9% of the height (value 1.0). Seven thin horizontal gridlines in #3A78B8 at roughly 29.6%, 37.2%, 44.9%, 52.5%, 60.2%, 67.9% and 75.5% of the height; the category axis line is light grey-white at 83.1%. Group bands are dark translucent navy rectangles with white text, drawn over the bar bases. No legend; no bars are highlighted.

**Design**

Background is a diagonal gradient from deep navy #0B1F45 at the top-left to royal blue #1B4A85 in the centre and dark blue #0E2C60 at the bottom-right. Title text is near-white #F2F8FF in a bold geometric sans (IntelOneDisplay-Bold style, similar to a Neue Haas or Helvetica-like grotesque) at about 7.6% of slide height. Subtitle is cyan #00C7FD in IntelOneDisplay-Light at about 4.1%. Chart labels and category text are white #FFFFFF in IntelOneDisplay-Regular at about 1.7% of slide height; the Relative Perf/W and baseline labels are about 2.0 to 2.2%. Group band text is white IntelOneDisplay-Regular at about 3.3%. Footnote is grey #BABABA in IntelOneText-Regular at about 1.5%. Bars have square ends and no shadows; the baseline is a white line about 0.6% of height thick with a faint grey shadow beneath.

### Slide 18

**Review notes**

- Review: Weaknesses are consequential: slides 4, 5, 10 and 12 pack in tiny labels, several benchmark charts (slides 18, 20, 24, 26) have axis labels too small to read, and about 30 backup slides are walls of microtext.

**Text**

Delivering Leading Performance for
Customer Workloads
Artificial Intelligence
Intelligence
Networking
5G
Storage
HPC
Data
Analytics
Intel XEON
Accelerate with Xeon

**Layout**

Single title block sits top-left at about 2.7% from the left and 6.5% from the top, set on two lines. Below it, five equal-width photo cards run in one row across the middle, with a 1.1% gutter, a left margin of about 5.7% and a right margin of about 5.4%, spanning y 33.8% to 79.6%. Each card is a photo over a dark navy caption panel, with its caption at the lower left. Faded reflections of the cards sit beneath them. The Intel XEON logo is bottom-left with the tagline 'Accelerate with Xeon' beside it. No slide number or footer is visible.

**Visuals**

Five photographs in a row, each in a boxed rectangle, none full-bleed, all the same size (about 17.0% wide by 26.0% tall). 1) Artificial Intelligence: extreme close-up of a face with the edge of a dark-framed pair of glasses; the lens reflects blue and green lines of computer code; pink skin tones on the right, dark blue-black on the left; shallow depth of field; tight framing. 2) Networking 5G: aerial view of a city at dusk under an orange-to-violet sunset sky; a glowing blue lattice of lines with bright white nodes spreads across the city lights, which are warm orange and white; wide framing. 3) Storage: a man in a green knit sweater and glasses holds a laptop and touches a dark server rack in a dark data-centre aisle; lit by a white strip light at the top and purple light at the right edge; medium framing, subject on the right. 4) HPC: rear view of a man with short blond hair in a grey hoodie facing several monitors showing data grids and charts; a second person with dark hair is partly visible at the upper left; blue-tinted monitor light; medium framing. 5) Data Analytics: a man in a light blue shirt at a desk with his hands on a keyboard, facing a monitor showing code; a second monitor on the right shows a glowing blue 3D point-cloud cube; server racks blurred behind; medium-wide framing. Below each photo the panel is a dark navy gradient, and beneath the cards are faded reflections of the photos. The XEON logo is a white bold 'intel' wordmark over cyan 'XEON' letters.

**Design**

Background: Navy blue gradient, about #0B1F45 at top-left to #16407A at centre to #0A2452 at bottom-right. Deep navy blue background with a subtle diagonal gradient, lighter blue near the centre-top and darker navy at the corners. Title in pale ice-blue #E6F4FF, with a heavy-weight geometric sans-serif (Intel One Display Bold style), about 7% of slide height, tight leading. Card captions in light cyan #5FD3F5, a light geometric sans-serif (Intel One Display Light style), about 3.8% of slide height, regular-to-light weight. Tagline in white #FFFFFF, Intel One Display Light, about 3.0% of slide height. Accent colour bright cyan #00C7FD for the XEON wordmark. Card panels are dark navy #0C2148 fading to #081633 at the bottom, with square corners, no border, and a soft dark shadow. Reflections are the photos mirrored below the cards at low opacity, fading to the background.

Full-bleed dark navy slide with a left-aligned two-line title block at the top (margin about 5.3% left) and a single vertical bar chart spanning nearly the full width below it. Category labels are rotated 45 degrees under each bar; the right-aligned footer disclaimer sits bottom right and the Intel XEON wordmark with tagline sits bottom left. No slide number is visible.

**Visuals**

Vertical bar chart titled '2S 4th Gen Intel Xeon Scalable Platform vs. Prior Generation' with subtitle 'Higher is better'. Y-axis title 'Normalized to 2S 3rd Gen Intel Xeon Scalable platform' (unitless ratio, baseline labelled '8380 =1.0' at the red reference line; no numeric axis ticks, gridlines unlabelled, range about 0 to 10.5). Bars are grouped by workload with dark translucent panels and white group labels: Database (bars 1-3), HPC (4-6), Web (7-11), Media (12-14), Network (15-21), AI (22-27). Each bar has a gradient fill in its group colour (Database cyan/blue, HPC blue, Web gold/yellow, Media light blue, Network mauve/pink, AI violet/indigo) and a white value label above it. Values in order: OLTP - HammerDB MySQL 1.50; NoSQL - Cassandra mix throughput 1.73; RocksDB 2.93; FSI - Binomial Options 1.58; Manufacturing - ESI Group OpenFOAM 1.64; Life/Material Science - LAMMPS 1.68; Earth System Model - ROMS 1.77; Wordpress TLS 1.3 1.47; Server-Side Java max 1.57; DeathStarBench - Hotel Reservation 1.61; DeathStarBench - Social Network 1.88; AVC-1080p-fast-avx2 (x264) 1.54; x265-4k-veryslow-avx2 1.65; SVT-HEVC-4k-preset1-avx3 1.75; NGINX TLS 1.3 Webserver AES128-GCM-SHA256 1.52; CDN Video-on-Demand [Varnish Plus] 1.80; CDN Live [NGINX] 1.74; FIB 1.88; FlexRAN 2.00; vCMTS 2.02; IPSEC 2.03; E2E Face Recognition 2.55; BERT (RT inference) 2.58; SSD-RN34 (RT inference) 4.86; Training BERT 4.00; Training SSD-RN34 5.46; SSD-RN34 (RT Inference BF16) 10.02. The four tallest bars (SSD-RN34 RT inference 4.86, Training BERT 4.00, Training SSD-RN34 5.46, SSD-RN34 RT Inference BF16 10.02) are capped with lighter lavender tops. A red horizontal reference line at the 1.0 level (8380 =1.0) runs across the full plot width, with a thin white-grey baseline under the bars. No legend; no highlighted points beyond the red line and the lighter caps.

**Design**

Background is a deep navy diagonal gradient from about #0B1F3A at top-left to #1B3F7A at centre and #14306A at bottom-right. Title text is white #FFFFFF in IntelOne Display Regular/Medium-weight sans-serif, roughly 7.5% of slide height. Subtitle is bright cyan #00C7FD in IntelOne Display Light, about 4.4% of slide height. Body and chart labels are white #FFFFFF in IntelOne Display Regular about 1.3-2.0% of slide height; group labels are IntelOne Text Regular 2.0%. Footer disclaimer is light grey #BABABA IntelOne Text Regular 1.5%. Accent colours: cyan #00C7FD, red reference line #FF0000, gridlines thin steel blue #2A6CA8 at about 1 px. Panels behind groups are darker navy #0A1A38 at about 40% opacity. Bars have vertical gradients from saturated colour to pale tint at the base; no shadows, no corner radius, no rounded shapes.

**Layout**

Single full-bleed slide with a left-aligned title block at the top (title then subtitle) above a full-width six-row table with four columns (Usages/Workload, Benchmark, Service Level Agreement (SLA) Requirement, Performance Gain*), all text centred within its column; a thin purple rule sits under the subtitle and rules close the header and the table bottom. Margins are about 5.3% left and right; the Intel Xeon logo and tagline sit bottom-left, the footnote and disclaimer bottom-right, and there is no slide number.

**Visuals**

None apart from the Intel Xeon logo at bottom left (intel wordmark in white over XEON in cyan #00C7FD) and the table's alternating shaded row bands (a 20 percent opacity #8F5DA2 tint on rows 1, 3 and 5, shown per column). The table has four columns and six data rows: Web Microservices / CloudXPRT / P95 latency < = 3sec / 1.5x; Java Application Performance / Server-Side Java (Critical JOPs) / Geomean of 10ms, 25ms, 50 ms, 75ms and 100ms response times / 1.6x; Cassandra Database / Cassandra Stress / P99 latency of <=20 ms / 1.7x; Microservices – Social Networking / DeathStarBench / 100 ms max SLA / 1.8x; Image Classification (Real-time) / Resnet50 v1.5 / 15 ms max / 3.0x; Object Detection (Real-time) / SSD-RN34 / 100 ms max / 4.8x.

**Design**

Background: Dark navy gradient from #0A1A33 at top-left through #163E6E in the centre to #0E2140 at bottom-right. Dark navy gradient background running from deep navy at the top-left to mid blue in the centre and darker navy at the bottom-right. Title in pale ice-blue-white #DDEEFF, subtitle in cyan #00C7FD, table text white #FFFFFF, footnote white and disclaimer grey #BABABA, rules and row tints in purple #8F5DA2. Title is a medium-weight geometric grotesque (Intel One Display style) at about 7 percent of slide height; subtitle is light weight at about 4 percent; table header is medium weight at about 3 percent; body rows regular at about 2.6 percent; disclaimer about 1.5 percent. Lines are about 1 px thin; shaded bands have square corners and no shadows.

### Slide 22

**Review notes**

- Worth studying: A three-column comparison of server counts, power, CO2 and cost savings turns fleet-level benefits into a concrete, easy-to-read table.
- Review: Readable slides such as 2, 8 and 22 have a clear subject, strong hierarchy and tidy alignment, and the TCO table on slide 22 is easy to scan with the savings percentages picked out in green.
- Worth keeping: Keep the large cyan stat callouts and the side-by-side table layout of slide 22, plus the consistent template that makes the deck feel unified.

**Layout**

Full-bleed dark navy slide with a left-aligned title block at top (title starts at x 4.0% and y 6.7%, subtitle below at y 13.8%), then an indented bold body paragraph at x 5.7%, y 20.7%. A full-width four-column table spans x 4.6% to 95.4% from y 32.4% to 85.5%, with a label column on the left and three data columns (Artificial Intelligence, Database, HPC). The footnote block sits bottom-right at x 74.0%, y 86.7% to 98.4%, and the Intel Xeon logo with tagline sits bottom-left at y 91.5% to 98.5%. No slide number is visible.

**Visuals**

One data table, no photographs, charts or icons. Columns: (1) row labels, (2) Artificial Intelligence (Real time Inferencing, RSN50 w/ Intel® AMX), (3) Database (Rocks DB w/Intel® IAA), (4) HPC (OpenFOAM). Rows: (a) Number of Intel Xeon processor-based servers: 17 servers with 4th Gen Intel® Xeon processors | 18 servers with 4th Gen Intel® Xeon processors | 16 servers with Intel® Xeon® CPU Max Series. (b) Lower Fleet Power (kilowatts): 22.1 kW | 15.4 kW | 25.7 kW. (c) Reduced CO2 emissions (kg)*: 524,000 kg | 366,000 kg | 611,000 kg. (d) TCO savings ($)*: $1.3M | $1.2M | $1.5M. (e) Green savings line, no row label: 55% Lower TCO | 52% Lower TCO | 66% Lower TCO. Row (a) and row (c) cells sit on a translucent purple-tinted band, row (b) and row (d) on the plain navy band. Row label column text is cyan, data values white, savings line green.

**Design**

Background is a dark navy gradient, darkest at top-left (about #0C1D3E) lightening to a mid blue (about #17407A) across the centre and lower right. Title is a bright white-to-pale-blue gradient (about #FFFFFF to #BFE6FF), set in a geometric sans-serif (Intel One Display Medium/Regular) at roughly 7% of slide height. Subtitle is Intel One Display Light in cyan #00C7FD at about 4.1% of slide height. Body paragraph is Intel One Display Medium, white #FFFFFF, about 3.3% of slide height. Column headers are Intel One Display Regular white, about 3.7%, with sub-lines in Light about 2.2%. Row labels are Intel One Display Regular cyan #00C7FD about 3.0%; values are Regular white about 3.3%. Savings percentages are Intel One Display Medium green #00B050 about 3.7%. Footnotes are Intel One Text Regular grey #BABABA about 1.5%. Table has thin hairline rules in purple #8F5DA2 at top and bottom and white hairlines between rows; cell bands are #8F5DA2 at 20% opacity or #153768 fills. No corner radii, shadows or gradients on the table.

### Slide 23

**Text**

4th Gen Intel® Xeon® Scalable Processors / for HPC Accelerated Performance / • Built-in acceleration to boost application / performance – Intel AVX 512, Intel DSA, Intel AMX / • New µarch, built on Intel 7, with up to 60 / performance cores for added compute / • Increased memory bandwidth and higher speeds / with DDR5 / • Higher IO bandwidth with PCIe 5. and support for / coherent interface with CXL 1.1 / Intel Advanced Vector / Extensions 512 (AVX-512) / Intel Advanced / Matrix Extensions (AMX) / Intel Data Streaming / Accelerator (DSA) / Accelerate with Xeon

**Layout**

Two-column grid below a full-width title: a large photo panel on the left (about 3.8% to 48.5% of width) and a dark text panel on the right (48.4% to 98.4%), both spanning roughly 24% to 75% of slide height. A three-cell icon strip sits under the photo panel, and an empty gradient strip sits under the text panel. The title is left-aligned at x 5.9% in two lines at the top (y 6% to 19%). The Intel Xeon logo lockup sits bottom-left at about y 92% with the tagline 'Accelerate with Xeon' beside it; there is no slide number or footer text.

**Visuals**

Photograph of a 4th Gen Intel Xeon Scalable processor package: a dark black rectangular substrate seen at an oblique three-quarter angle, rotated so its long edge runs from lower-left to upper-right, with four gold-tinted heat-spreader tiles (chiplets) in a 2x2 arrangement at its centre and pin/contact edges visible along the sides. It is lit from above with a soft shadow falling beneath it to the lower left, shown on a blue-to-purple gradient background; the image is boxed (not full-bleed) inside the left panel, with the product cut out from its background. Dominant colours: black, gold, violet #6A3FB5, blue #2F6FD0, cyan #4FC8E8. A small Intel XEON logo box sits in the top-left corner of the photo panel (intel wordmark over XEON wordmark on a dark blue #1B4F9C square, with lighter blue vertical bands). Three white line icons sit in the icon strip: a chip with a vector/circuit-like cut-out outline (AVX-512); a chip with a centred 'Ai' glyph in a box (AMX); a stacked server/streaming-storage icon with a dot (DSA). Bullets are small white solid dots. The lower-right panel is an empty decorative gradient bar from dark indigo #2A2A7A at the top edge to blue #2E5FB0 and teal #3A8FC0 at the bottom right, with a thin lighter band along its top.

**Design**

Background: Diagonal dark-blue gradient from navy #0B1F3A at top-left through blue #1B4F9C to deeper blue #123A7A at bottom-right.

**Layout**

Two-zone layout: a left text column (headline block and subtitle) occupies roughly the left 30 percent, and a full-width vertical bar chart with section panels fills the right 65 percent from about y 17 to y 72. The chart title sits above the chart at top-left of the plot, and the section labels sit at the top of each panel. The Intel XEON logo is in the top-left corner at x 1.1 y 4.8, the Intel XEON lockup and tagline are bottom-left, and the footnote block sits at bottom-centre-right from x 24.8 to x 92.6, y 88.5 to 94.1. There is no slide number visible.

**Visuals**

Vertical bar chart titled Relative Perf. Higher is better (no units; y-axis is relative performance, linear, range 0 to about 3.3, gridlines and tick labels at 0, 0.5, 1, 1.5, 2, 2.5, 3; faint dotted horizontal gridlines). X-axis: 26 categories, rotated 45 degrees labels. Series: single series of bars with printed value labels above each bar. Printed values in order: Intel Xeon 8380 1.0 (baseline bar, violet-blue); MPAS-A 1.7; NEMO 1.7; ROMS 1.8; WRF 1.6; Anelastic Wave Propagation 1.6; ISO3DFD 1.7; Standard Staggered Grid 1.6; Binomial Options 1.6; Black Scholes 1.4; Monte Carlo 1.4; DeepMD Training 1.5; GROMACS 1.5; LAMMPS 1.7; Quantum Espresso 1.4; VASP 1.6; Altair AcuSolve 1.4; Altair RADIOSS 1.3; Ansys Fluent 1.6; Ansys LS-DYNA 1.4; Ansys Mechanical 1.4; CONVE, RGE 1.6; OpenFOAM 1.6; ParSeNet 1.4; Siemens Simcenter Star-CCM+ 1.5; Cosmoflow 2.6 (the tallest bar, highest point, no highlight colour beyond the bar itself). Groups: Earth Systems Modeling (MPAS-A, NEMO, ROMS), Energy (WRF, Anelastic Wave Propagation, ISO3DFD), Financial Services (Standard Staggered Grid, Binomial Options, Black Scholes), Life and Material Science (Monte Carlo, DeepMD Training, GROMACS, LAMMPS, Quantum Espresso), Manufacturing (VASP, Altair AcuSolve, Altair RADIOSS, Ansys Fluent, Ansys LS-DYNA, Ansys Mechanical, CONVE, RGE, OpenFOAM, ParSeNet, Siemens Simcenter Star-CCM+), Physics (Cosmoflow). A horizontal reference line at 1.0 in grey-violet crosses all bars. No legend. Highlighted points: the Intel Xeon 8380 baseline bar is the only bar in a different colour (violet-blue #5B6CFF). Intel XEON badge logo at top-left, Intel XEON wordmark logo at bottom-left, and a small Intel logo at bottom-left above XEON.

**Design**

Background: Full-bleed dark navy gradient (top-left #0B1A3A to centre #1A4A8A to bottom-right #0C1E45). Dark navy gradient background running from deep navy #0B1A3A at top-left to brighter cobalt #1A4A8A toward the centre and darker #0C1E45 at bottom-right. Headline text is white #FFFFFF in IntelOne Display Medium (geometric sans-serif, medium weight), about 8.2 percent of slide height for the 2.6x numeral and about 4.4 percent for Up to, Performance and On Real Workloads. Subtitle is light grey #BABABA at about 2.9 percent of slide height, IntelOne Text Regular. Chart labels and section labels are white #FFFFFF in IntelOne Text Regular at about 1.3 to 2.0 percent of slide height. Bars are cyan-to-blue vertical gradients from bright cyan #00C4F5 at the top to deep teal-blue #0A4D7A near the baseline; the baseline bar is violet-blue #5B6CFF. Section panels are thin white or light blue vertical divider rules with dark navy translucent fills (about #0B1F45 at partial opacity), and the top edges of the panels have a thin bright blue #1E90FF rule. Accent colour is cyan #00C4F5. Footnotes are grey #BABABA at about 1.3 percent of slide height. Bar edges are square, no shadows, no rounded corners.

**Layout**

Single-column composition on a full-bleed dark blue background. A small cyan eyebrow label INTRODUCING sits above the title, which is left-aligned at about 4% from the left edge in the upper-left area. Three horizontal dark bands stack vertically in the left two-thirds, each holding one left-aligned statement with its text starting at about 8.2% from the left. A product image of the Xeon Max chip sits at the right, overlapping the upper two bands. Thin cyan bracket lines frame the bands on the left, top right and bottom. A small Intel Xeon logo box sits at the lower right. The Intel Xeon logo and the tagline Accelerate with Xeon sit in the bottom-left corner. No page number or date is visible.

**Visuals**

Product image: a square boxed render of an Intel Xeon CPU Max Series package, placed at about x72.2 y31.5 w20.4 h36.2 (percent of slide). Within it, the white lowercase intel wordmark with registered mark sits at top left, a large silver-to-white XEON wordmark with registered mark sits in the middle, and a blue band labelled MAX SERIES in white capitals sits at the bottom left. The background of the render is black fading to deep blue with a diagonal light sheen. A vertical blue-grey side strip runs along the right edge of the render. The render is not cropped and is boxed, with a faint blue glow behind it. Small logo tile: a square blue-gradient tile at about x86.5 y70.8 w7.7 h13.7 showing the white intel wordmark above the cyan XEON wordmark. Bottom-left logo: the white intel wordmark above the cyan XEON wordmark, at about x1.0 y91.6 w21.2 h6.7. Decorative lines: cyan (#00C7FD) hairline brackets. One runs vertically at x5.2 from y22.6 to y77.3 with a short horizontal stub at its top from x5.2 to x13. A second runs at the upper right, horizontal from x83.2 to x90.4 at y25, then vertical down at x90.4 from y25 to y76.5. A horizontal cyan line runs at y80 from x5.2 to about x89.7, fading to transparent toward the right.

**Design**

Background is a diagonal gradient from deep navy at top-left (#10203F) through mid blue at upper centre (#1A3F70) to dark navy at bottom-right (#0B1F4A). Title text is near-white with a pale blue tint (#E3F3FF), set in a bold geometric sans-serif (Intel One Display style) at about 9.5% of slide height for the title cap height region. Eyebrow INTRODUCING is regular-weight sans-serif in cyan #00C7FD, all capitals, about 2.6% of slide height. Body statements are light-weight sans-serif (IntelOneDisplay-Light) in cyan #00C7FD at about 4.44% of slide height, roughly 0.9 of the cap height ratio. Footer tagline is light sans-serif in white #FFFFFF at about 2.96% of slide height. Bands are rectangles filled with translucent dark navy (#0A1A33 at about 70% opacity) with a thin lighter blue separator line (#1E4A80) between them, square corners, no shadow. Accent colour is cyan #00C7FD. The product render has square corners with a soft shadow.

**Layout**

A two-part layout on a 16:9 slide: the title block and a left column of stat strips occupy the upper-left and left half, while three equal-height memory-mode panels run across the lower right under a 'Memory modes' heading. The title sits top-left below the Xeon MAX badge, left-aligned at about 4.6% from the left edge, with the chip photo floating in the upper right; the Intel Xeon lockup and tagline form a footer at bottom left, and there is no slide number.

**Visuals**

Photograph of the Intel Xeon Max processor package, shown as a tilted, floating render in the upper-right quadrant (x 59.1, y 0, w 39.8, h 44.7). It shows a dark charcoal-black package with a grid of silver and gold-beige compute and memory tiles on a dark substrate with fine circuit traces and small rectangular pins along its edges; it is lit from above with soft highlights on the metallic tiles, is not cropped (it sits on the blue background with no box, and its top edge runs to the top of the slide), and has no overlay. Logo: intel XEON MAX SERIES badge at top-left (x 1.1, y 4.3, w 9.3, h 16.5), a dark navy square with the intel wordmark in white, XEON in large silver-white letters and a light-blue MAX SERIES band at the bottom. Icon: small HBM2e module graphic in the left stat strip (x 4.4, y 44.3, w 3.3, h 13.1), a grey memory package with a vertical HBM label and orange-gold edge tabs. Stat strip contents: 64GB, HBM2e, up to 112.5MB shared LLC, DDR5 8 channels per CPU at 4800MTS (1DPC) and 16 DIMMs per socket, separated by thin vertical divider lines. Diagram, HBM Only panel: one gold rectangle labelled HBM (x 45.3, y 88.6, w 10.2, h 6.7) sitting at the bottom of the panel. Diagram, HBM Flat Mode panel: a gold rectangle labelled HBM (x 58.6, y 77.5, w 10.2, h 6.7) stacked directly above a larger grey rectangle labelled DDR (x 58.6, y 83.0, w 10.2, h 12.2), touching with no arrows. Diagram, HBM Caching Mode panel: a gold rectangle labelled HBM (x 74.1, y 82.7, w 10.2, h 6.7) on the left, a translucent pale-blue trapezoid funnel narrowing from the HBM box toward the right, and a larger grey rectangle labelled DDR (x 86.1, y 79.9, w 10.2, h 12.2) on the right, so the funnel connects HBM to DDR. Gold blocks are flat with a subtle bevel; grey blocks have a brushed metallic gradient.

**Design**

Background: Dark navy to royal blue diagonal gradient, darkest #0A2150 at top-left shifting to #1A4A8C at bottom-right.

**Layout**

Full-bleed dark navy slide with free-form layout: a narrow left column (about 0 to 25 percent of width) holds the Max Series badge, the headline stack and the caption, while the bar chart fills the right area from about x 13 to 96 percent and y 19 to 74 percent. Six section headers sit in a row above the plot at y 20 to 23 percent, with the 'Relative Perf. Higher is better' note just above them at y 17.6 percent. The legend sits centred under the category labels at y 86 percent, footnotes are set left-aligned from x 23 percent at y 88.6 to 95 percent, and the Intel XEON logo and tagline are bottom-left at x 1 to 22 percent. No slide number or footer is visible.

**Visuals**

Chart: vertical grouped bar chart, title none, subtitle 'Relative Perf. Higher is better'. Y axis: relative performance, unitless, linear, range 0 to 4 with labelled ticks at 0, 0.5, 1, 1.5, 2, 2.5, 3, 3.5, 4 and faint dotted horizontal gridlines. X axis: 26 workload categories (Intel Xeon 8380 reference plus 25 applications) with rotated labels at about 45 degrees. Series 1 (dark blue, 4th Gen Intel Xeon Scalable processor, left bar): Intel Xeon 8380 reference 1.0 (the reference bar is a brighter violet-blue), MPAS-A 1.7, NEMO 1.7, ROMS 1.8, WRF 1.6, Anelastic Wave Propagation 1.6, ISO3DFD 1.7, Standard Staggered Grid 1.6, Binomial Options 1.6, Black Scholes 1.4, Monte Carlo 1.4, DeePMD Training 1.5, GROMACS 1.5, LAMMPS 1.7, Quantum Espresso 1.4, VASP 1.6, Altair AcuSolve 1.4, Altair RADIOSS 1.3, Ansys Fluent 1.6, Ansys LS-DYNA 1.4, Ansys Mechanical 1.4, CONVE.RGE 1.6, OpenFOAM 1.6, ParSeNet 1.4, Siemens Simcenter STAR-CCM+ 1.5, Cosmoflow 2.6. Series 2 (teal-cyan, Intel Xeon CPU Max Series, right bar): MPAS-A 3.3, NEMO 3.3, ROMS 2.7, WRF 2.7, Anelastic Wave Propagation 3.7, ISO3DFD 2.9, Standard Staggered Grid 3.7, Binomial Options 1.4, Black Scholes 1.6, Monte Carlo 1.3, DeePMD Training 2.9, GROMACS 1.5, LAMMPS 1.6, Quantum Espresso 1.7, VASP 2.0, Altair AcuSolve 2.4, Altair RADIOSS 1.9, Ansys Fluent 2.1, Ansys LS-DYNA 1.6, Ansys Mechanical 1.6, CONVE.RGE 1.6, OpenFOAM 3.2, ParSeNet 2.1, Siemens Simcenter STAR-CCM+ 1.7, Cosmoflow 3.0. Values are printed above each bar. Highlighted: a horizontal light-blue reference line at value 1.0 spanning the full plot width. Also a large headline callout 'Up to 3.7x performance on real world workloads' in the left column.

**Design**

Background: Deep navy gradient from #0F2556 (top left) to #1C4A82 (centre) to #0D2A58 (bottom right). **Layout**

Four equal-sized content cards arranged in a 2x2 grid below a left-aligned title block, with the Xeon badge logo at top right. Each card pairs a square-cornered photograph on the left with a dark text panel on the right; the left column cards sit at x about 5 to 49 percent and the right column at x about 51 to 95 percent. The title sits top left at about x 2.8 percent, y 7.6 percent, with the subtitle beneath it; the footer has the Intel XEON lockup bottom left and a small disclaimer bottom right, with no slide number visible.

**Visuals**

Four rectangular photographs in the cards, all unboxed with square corners and no overlay on the photo itself. (1) Life Sciences, top left: brain MRI scans on illuminated light boxes, a person's hand pointing at a scan, a blurred red glow in the upper centre, blue and teal dominant tones, cropped tight on the scans. (2) Digital Consumer Web Services, top right: extreme close-up of eyeglass lenses reflecting lines of green and white code on a screen, blue and purple tones, shallow depth of field, cropped to the lens and frame edge. (3) Financial Services, bottom left: a woman in a patterned blouse seated in front of multiple monitors showing green and red stock charts, dark room with warm blurred bokeh lights in the background, cool blue and green dominant colours, subject cropped at the right edge. (4) Retail, bottom right: hands holding a black smartphone showing a Fashion app with a green banner reading 30% OFF DRESSES and a button reading SHOP SALE NOW!, a person in a green knit sweater holding a coffee cup on a white surface, bright natural daylight, cool white and green tones, cropped at the top and left. Also a Xeon badge logo top right: a blue square tile with the intel wordmark at top, the XEON wordmark in white below, and a darker blue block at bottom right. Also an Intel XEON logo lockup bottom left: intel wordmark in white over XEON in cyan.

**Design**

Background: Dark navy gradient, from about #0E2148 at top left through #173F73 at centre to #0A1A33 at bottom right. Dark navy gradient background running from deep navy at top left to a slightly lighter blue in the centre and darker navy at bottom right. Title in white IntelOneDisplay Medium bold sans-serif, subtitle and the card headings in bright cyan IntelOneDisplay Light sans-serif, card body text in white IntelOneDisplay Medium sans-serif. Title is about 6.7 percent of slide height, card headings about 5.6 percent, body text about 3.3 percent, footer tagline about 3.0 percent, disclaimer about 1.5 percent in grey. Card panels are near-black navy gradients from #0A1A33 on the left to #0B1A2E at the right edge, with square corners and no borders or shadows.

### Slide 29

**Text**

Architected to Accelerate Real World Workloads / Cloud / Live migration performance / Up to 89% performance increase with Intel® QAT vs. prior gen. 11 / Better user experience and cost efficiency / “We were pleased to observe a 20% increase in performance over the current generation C2 VMs from Google Cloud in testing with one of our key workloads.” 12 / inspur / Google Cloud / Security / Helping Secure AI workloads / Intel® SGX performs up to 4.6x higher vs. prior gen. 13 / Fortanix / AI / Data purification / Up to 2.48x performance improvement with Intel® AMX vs. prior gen. 14 / Alibaba / Sentiment analysis / Up to 4x performance gain with Intel® AMX vs. prior gen. 15 / BRAINPOOL.AI / FUJITSU / Graph neural network training / “Intel’s [4th Gen Xeon processor] provides unprecedented levels of performance for critical graph intelligence tasks.” / KATANA GRAPH / 5G / Virtualized network / “It is not just a software, it is not interfaces, it is not only radio. It is how we can build all the pieces in our architecture.” / Telefónica / HPC / High energy physics / Up to 4.3x performance improvement with Intel AMX® on Intel Xeon Max Series vs. prior gen. 16 / CERN openlab / SURF / Climate simulation / Up to 8.57x performance improvement on Intel Xeon Max Series vs. Intel E5V4. 17 / Los Alamos NATIONAL LABORATORY / Hewlett Packard Enterprise / Sustainable liquid cooling / "The reason we use the 4th Gen Intel® Xeon® processor as the building block for immersion born systems is really because of its unrivaled power and efficiency.” / Hypertec / intel XEON / Accelerate with Xeon

**Layout**

Full-bleed 16:9 slide with the title across the top-left at about 7.6% from the top and 1.8% from the left margin, left-aligned. Below it a modular grid of five dark panels: Cloud (wide, top-left, two cards side by side), Security (top-right, one card), AI (middle-left, three cards in a row), 5G (middle-right, one card) and HPC (bottom, full width, three cards in a row). Each section label sits top-left inside its panel, with white cards below it, left-aligned, all in a consistent gutter of about 1%. The Intel XEON lockup and tagline sit bottom-left at about 92% to 99% of the height, with no page number or footer visible.

**Visuals**

Five translucent dark navy panels (Cloud, Security, AI, 5G, HPC) form a modular grid behind ten white cards. Each card holds a short claim, a performance figure, and a logo. Logos shown: inspur (blue wordmark, Cloud card 1), Google Cloud (multicolour cloud icon with grey wordmark, Cloud card 2), Snapchat (yellow square with white ghost outline), Fortanix (purple-navy wordmark with a multicolour bar icon), Alibaba (orange wordmark with a stylised orange 'a' mark), BRAINPOOL.AI (grey wordmark with a teal circle), FUJITSU (red wordmark), KATANA GRAPH (black circle icon with a K-shaped mark and black wordmark), Telefónica (blue wordmark with a three-dot mark), CERN openlab (multicolour dot icon with blue and grey wordmark), SURF (black wordmark on a black swoosh box), Los Alamos National Laboratory (navy circular icon with navy wordmark), Hewlett Packard Enterprise (green bracket mark with dark grey wordmark), Hypertec (blue diamond icon with navy wordmark), and the Intel XEON logo (white intel wordmark over cyan XEON). Footnote superscripts 11 to 17 follow the figures.

**Design**

Background is a dark blue diagonal gradient from deep navy at top-left to mid-blue at bottom-right. Title is pale blue-white, large sans-serif. Section labels are bright cyan. Card titles are dark grey, medium weight. Body copy is dark grey regular. Accents are cyan #00C7FD. Typefaces are IntelOne Display for the title and labels (geometric sans-serif) and IntelOne Text for body copy (sans-serif). ### Slide 30

**Text**

An Architecture / Influenced by / Customers / Workload-first approach to innovation, / design, and delivery / Unique Die, SKU, features / for Unique Market Needs / DDR5, PCIe5 and / CXL here today / Cores + Accelerators / deliver better value / Most built-in accelerators / of any CPU on the market / Increased performance, / power and cost efficiency / Accelerating AI, Analytics, / Networking, Storage, HPC / 2.9x higher avg / performance gains / Leading performance / and efficiency for our customers / Only x86 CPU to offer 4S / and 8S scalability & HBM / Up to 10X higher AI / inference and training / Lower TCO and / power consumption / intel XEON / Accelerate with Xeon / See backup for workloads and configurations. Results may vary.

**Layout**

Two-zone layout: a large right-aligned title block and a 3-row stack of headline panels with three-column text grids on the right, with the chip illustration in the lower-left area. The Intel XEON logo sits bottom-left and the footnote bottom-right, both on a common margin of about 1 to 5 percent from the slide edges.

**Visuals**

One photograph-style 3D illustration of a black Intel Xeon processor package, at about 3/4 perspective, floating over the left half of the slide. Its dark substrate is studded with fine gold traces and small rectangular pads. Above it, several gold-coloured chiplet tiles are exploded upward in stacked layers, with small orange-brown capacitors on the substrate. Soft studio lighting highlights the gold tiles against the dark navy background. The image is not cropped, not boxed and has no overlay. Dominant colours are black, gold #C9A24A and navy. No charts or tables.

**Design**

Background is a dark navy diagonal gradient from about #0B1F3A at top-left to about #1E4F8C at bottom-right. Title text is pale white-blue #E6F8FF in a geometric sans-serif display face (Intel One Display style) at a large size, roughly 6.5 percent of slide height. Panel headings are light cyan #B4F0FF in Intel One Display Regular at about 4.4 percent of slide height. Sub-items are white #FFFFFF in Intel One Display Medium at about 2.6 percent, centred. Heading panels are semi-transparent dark navy rectangles (about #0A1A33 at around 70 percent opacity) with square corners. Outline frames are thin 1 px cyan #3FB8F0 rectangles with square corners and no shadow. Footer is light grey #BABABA in Intel One Text Regular at about 1.5 percent. No shadows or gradients on text.

### Slide 31

**Text**

Thank you!
4th Gen
Intel Xeon Scalable Processor
intel
XEON
intel
XEON
Accelerate with Xeon

**Layout**

Centred single-line title sits in the upper-middle band above a horizontal row of three product images (angled chip package left, upright boxed CPU centre, angled chip package right) enclosed by a thin cyan bracket frame that opens at the top corners. A small Intel Xeon badge sits bottom right inside the frame's corner, and the Intel Xeon wordmark with the tagline 'Accelerate with Xeon' sits bottom left at about 7% left margin. No slide number or footer text is visible.

**Visuals**

Three product photographs and one badge, all on a navy background. Left: a 3D-rendered Xeon chip package tilted about 20 degrees, viewed from the front-left, with a stack of translucent glass-like tile layers floating above a black substrate with gold die tiles, drawn with soft motion blur at the upper-left edge; the substrate is cropped at no edge and lit from above with soft highlights; dominant colours black, gold and pale grey-blue. Centre: a front-on photograph of a silver-grey boxed Intel Xeon Scalable processor, upright, with a gold contact pad strip at top and bottom, printed 'intel' and 'XEON' wordmarks in dark grey and '4th Gen / Intel Xeon Scalable Processor' in dark grey text; lit evenly, dominant colours silver and dark grey. Right: a 3D-rendered Xeon package tilted in the opposite direction, showing a gold multi-die top with four labelled tiles (tiny illegible die labels such as 'CHA LLC & Core Mesh') on a black substrate with edge connectors; lit from upper-left, dominant colours black and gold. Badge: a square dark-blue tile with a subtle gradient containing the white 'intel' wordmark over a cyan 'XEON' wordmark, bottom right. Bracket frame: thin cyan #1EB4F0 lines about 0.3% of slide width; a horizontal bottom line from x 7.2 to 91.6 at y 77.4, a vertical right line at x 92.3 from y 22.6 to 74.1, and short top stubs at y 22.6 from x 7.2 to 13.7 and from x 85.7 to 92.3; the bottom line fades to transparent toward the right end. Footer logo: white 'intel' over cyan 'XEON' wordmark, bottom left.

**Design**

Background: Navy #0E2A5C to #1A4B8C diagonal gradient running from top-left to bottom-right, covering the full slide. Full navy gradient background running from deep navy #0B1F3A at the top-left to mid blue #1A4B8C at the centre to dark navy #0E2A5C at the bottom-right. Title in a light weight geometric sans with a pale cyan-to-blue gradient fill, about #7FD4F5 at the left to #4FB8E8 at the right; body and tagline text in white #FFFFFF. Accent colour cyan #1EB4F0 for the bracket lines and the 'XEON' wordmark. Title typeface: Intel One Display Light (a light sans-serif), title roughly 18 percent of slide height, sentence case, no italics. Tagline: Intel One Display Light, about 3 percent of slide height. Lines are plain 2 px cyan strokes with square ends; no corner radii on the frame; the badge tile has a soft drop shadow beneath the tile; the chip photographs carry soft ground shadows.

**Layout**

Single slide with a title at top left (left edge about 5.6% of width, top about 6.3% of height) and content on a symmetrical grid of two equal panels in the upper row with one full-width panel beneath them, all centred on the slide with margins of about 8% to 9% on left and right. Three product logo tiles sit bottom right above a footnote at the bottom right, and the Intel Xeon logo lockup with tagline sits bottom left; no slide number is visible.

**Visuals**

Five visual elements: (1) a full-bleed diagonal navy gradient background; (2) a cyan bracket-style outline framing the three panels, drawn as thin lines with a left vertical, a top-left horizontal segment, a top-right horizontal segment, a right vertical and a bottom horizontal that fades to the right; (3) three dark translucent rectangular panels with soft drop shadows; (4) three product logo tiles bottom right; (5) the Intel Xeon logo lockup bottom left. Logo tiles from left to right: first, a blue-grey tile reading intel. over XEON with a dark lower band; second, a black tile reading intel. over XEON with a MAX SERIES bar; third, a dark blue tile reading intel. over DATA CENTER GPU with a MAX SERIES bar. No photographs or charts are present.

**Design**

Background is a diagonal navy-to-royal-blue gradient, darkest at the top-left and bottom-right corners (about #0F2350 and #0D2255) and mid-blue in the centre (about #1B4A80). The title is set in a bold geometric sans-serif (IntelOneDisplay Bold, close to Intel One Display) in pale ice blue #E6F4FF at about 15% of slide height. Headings are light-weight sans-serif at about 5.4% of height in a gradient: Intel Xeon Scalable runs violet-blue (about #8B8CF5), Intel Max CPU + GPU runs bright blue (about #2AA5F0), and Unrivaled Software Ecosystem runs pale blue to steel blue (about #7FC8E8). Body text is light-weight sans-serif in white #FFFFFF at about 3.7% of height. Footnote text is regular sans-serif in grey #BABABA at about 1.5%. Accents are cyan #1EB4F0 for the bracket lines. Panels are near-black navy (about #0B1A33) with soft dark shadows, square corners and no borders.

**Layout**

Title block sits top-left with the title on one line and a cyan subtitle beneath it, starting at about 5.5% from the left edge. The body is three columns: a left column of four stacked full-width cards (x 5.5 to 49%) and two tall equal-width cards on the right (x 50.2 to 95%), each with a column header above it at about y 18 to 24%. The footer holds the Intel XEON logo and tagline at bottom-left and a small right-aligned source line at bottom-right; no slide number is visible.

**Visuals**

No charts or tables. Four rectangular text cards on the left (Function, Business Value, Software Support, Use Cases) with flat fill #0D1C33 and no visible outline. Two tall vertical panels on the right, each a dark navy gradient card (darker at the right edge) with a soft drop shadow and a faint reflection below it: the left panel shows the headline Network Secure Gateway and the stat 84%; the right panel shows Enterprise Storage and Data Analytics and the stats 95% and 2x. The Intel XEON logo at bottom-left is white intel over cyan XEON, with the cyan XEON wordmark in #00C7FD. Background is a full-slide blue gradient image with no photograph or pattern.

**Design**

Background is a deep navy to mid-blue diagonal gradient, darker at top-left (#0A1830) and lighter blue toward the centre and lower-left (#1B4A80). Title is white #FFFFFF shading to pale blue #CFEFFF, in IntelOneDisplay Medium sans-serif, around 7.6% of slide height. Subtitle Acceleration Engine is cyan #00C7FD in IntelOneDisplay Light. Section headings are cyan #00C7FD in IntelOneDisplay Regular, about 3% of height. Body text is white #FFFFFF in IntelOneDisplay Light, about 2.6% of height. Column headers are white #FFFFFF in IntelOneDisplay Medium, about 2.6%. Large statistics 84%, 95% and 2x are lavender #CC94DA in IntelOneDisplay Light, about 8.9% of height. Bullets are white Wingdings square markers. Cards have square corners, no outlines, and no gradients apart from the right-hand panels. Footnote is grey #BABABA in IntelOneText Regular, about 1.5%.

### Slide 38

**Text**

Intel® Advanced Matrix Extensions / Acceleration Engine / Performance gains / vs prior generation products / Performance gains / vs prior generation products / Function / ▪ Provides extensive hardware and software optimizations / to enhance AI acceleration / Business Value / ▪ Significant performance increases for AI/Deep Learning / inference and training workloads / ▪ Delivers common applications faster through / hardware acceleration / Software Support / ▪ Market relevant frameworks, toolkits and libraries (PyTorch, / TensorFlow), Intel® oneAPI Deep Neural Network Library (oneDNN) / Use Cases / ▪ Image recognition, recommendation systems, machine/ / language translation, NLP, media processing, and delivery / Speech Recognition / Inference / Up to / 8.6x / higher speech recognition / inference performance with / built-in Intel® Advanced / Matrix Extensions (Intel® AMX) (BF16) vs. the prior generation (FP32) / PyTorch Training / and Inference / Up to / 10x / higher PyTorch for both real-time inference and training performance with built-in Intel® Advanced Matrix Extensions (Intel® AMX) (BF16) vs. the prior generation (FP32) / Accelerate with Xeon / See backup for workloads and configurations. Results may vary.

**Layout**

Left-aligned title block at top-left (x about 5.5%, y about 6% to 17%) with a light-blue subtitle beneath it. A left column of four stacked dark panels (x 5.5% to 49.4%) holds the Function, Business Value, Software Support and Use Cases sections. Two tall stat panels sit in the right half, at x 51.1% and x 74.2%, each headed by a two-line 'Performance gains / vs prior generation products' label above it. The Intel Xeon logo sits bottom-left with the tagline 'Accelerate with Xeon' beside it, and a small disclaimer sits bottom-right. No slide number is visible.

**Visuals**

Full-slide dark blue gradient background image with no photograph. Four flat rectangular text panels in the left column, all filled #0D1C33, with no visible borders. Two tall rectangular stat panels in the right half, dark navy with a subtle vertical darkening toward the bottom and a soft drop shadow beneath each, one stat per panel: Speech Recognition Inference, Up to 8.6x, higher speech recognition inference performance with built-in Intel® Advanced Matrix Extensions (Intel® AMX) (BF16) vs. the prior generation (FP32); PyTorch Training and Inference, Up to 10x, higher PyTorch for both real-time inference and training performance with built-in Intel® Advanced Matrix Extensions (Intel® AMX) (BF16) vs. the prior generation (FP32). No charts. Intel and XEON logos bottom-left.

**Design**

Background is a deep navy to mid-blue diagonal gradient, darker at top-left and lighter toward the centre. Titles are white (#FFFFFF) in a geometric sans-serif (Intel One Display, Medium weight) at about 8.9% of slide height for the main title. The subtitle 'Acceleration Engine' is cyan #00C7FD in a light sans-serif at about 4.1% of height. Section headings are cyan #00C7FD in Intel One Display Regular at about 3.0% of height. Body text is white #FFFFFF in Intel One Display Light at about 2.6% of height. Accent stat numbers are lavender #CC94DA in Intel One Display Light at about 8.9% of height. Bullets are white square glyphs (Wingdings ▪). Panels have square corners and no outline. Shadows are soft and dark beneath the stat panels.

Under it is a header bar labelled 4th Gen Intel Xeon Scalable processors spanning six tiles and a second bar labelled Intel Xeon CPU Max Series over the last tile. The six tiles, left to right, are: General Purpose Compute, 53% average performance gen; Artificial Intelligence, Up to 10x higher inference and training performance; Network 5G vRAN, Up to 2x capacity for vRAN workloads at same power envelope; Networking and Storage, Up to 2x higher data compression with 95% fewer cores; Data Analytics, Up to 3x higher performance; HPC, Up to 3.7x on memory-bound workloads. The background is a full-slide dark blue gradient image, not a photograph.

**Layout**

The Intel Xeon logo and 'Accelerate with Xeon' tagline sit in the bottom-left corner at about 92% to 98% of the height. There is no slide number or footer.

**Visuals**

1) Boxed screenshot in top-right (x 72.7%, y 0%, w 27.3%, h 27.9%). It shows a slide titled 'Built for Sustainable Operations' with two panels. Left panel: a line chart titled 'Energy Efficiency (Java Perf/W)'. Y axis 'Power (W)' runs 0 to 800 in steps of 100. X axis 'Server-Side Java Performance' runs 0 to 12,000,000 in steps of 2,000,000. Two series: 'Out of Box' (blue line, labelled values about 423, 487, 545, 594, 625, 637, 657, 677, 696, 697, 698) and 'Optimized Power Mode' (green line, labelled values about 274, 344, 406, 466, 514, 549, 578, 620, 668, 678, 690). Shaded zones are labelled 'Low to Intermediate CPU utilization (Jumps ~40%)', 'Medium CPU utilization', and 'High/Peak CPU utilization'. Legend at bottom: 'Out of Box' and 'Optimized Power Mode'. Right panel: dark navy box with cyan heading 'Optimized Power Mode' and white text: 'Saves up to 20% CPU power at less than 5% performance impact for selected workloads', 'Saves power where customers tend to run (~30-40% utilization)', bullet 'up to 70W per socket at low utilization', 'Easy button BIOS option to enable (CSP, OxM, End User)'. **Layout**

Full-bleed dark navy slide with a large title across the top left, a two-line subtitle block and a bulleted list of workloads in a single left-aligned column below, with the list running almost the full width. A boxed infographic sits in the top-right corner. The Intel XEON logo and tagline sit in the bottom-left corner. No slide number, footer text or date is visible.

**Visuals**

One raster infographic in the top-right corner titled 'Architecting to Accelerate Customer Workloads' with subtitle 'Leading Performance with most built-in accelerators'. It has a header bar reading '4th Gen Intel® Xeon® Scalable processors' spanning most of its width and a narrower box 'Xeon Max CPU'. Six dark navy metric tiles: 'General Purpose Compute' 53% 'average performance gain*'; 'Artificial Intelligence' Up to 10x 'higher inference and training performance*'; 'Network 5G vRAN' Up to 2x 'capacity for vRAN workloads at same power envelope*'; 'Networking & Storage' Up to 2x 'higher data compression with 95% fewer cores*'; 'Data Analytics' Up to 3x 'higher performance*'; 'HPC' Up to 3.7x 'on memory-bound workloads**'. A wide bottom bar reads 'Performance per Watt' 2.9x 'average improvement with built-in accelerators*'. Tiny footnotes and 'Accelerate with Xeon' logo in the bottom-left of the graphic. Numbers in cyan, labels in white, dark navy tile fill, boxed with a thin light outline; the graphic is not cropped. The image is not a photograph and has no overlay.

**Design**

Background: Dark navy gradient (about #0A1A33 top-left to #14407A bottom-right) covering the full slide. Dark navy gradient background, darker at top-left (about #0A1A33) and lighter toward bottom-right (about #14407A). Title in very light blue-white (about #E6F3FF), large sans-serif (Intel One Display style, regular weight), about 17% of slide height. Subtitle and body text in white (#FFFFFF) Intel One Display Light sans-serif; subtitle about 1.7% of slide height, body about 1.1 to 1.5%. Bullets are small white ArialMT dots. Accent colour cyan (about #00C7FD) used for the XEON wordmark and the infographic numbers. No shapes, rules or shadows apart from the boxed infographic with a thin light outline and square corners.
