Below the title, a sub-heading starts at 26.1% and five bulleted paragraphs run in one left-aligned column from x 4.3 to about 92.3, ending near 88% height. The Intel XEON logo and the tagline 'Accelerate with Xeon' form the footer at bottom-left; no page number is visible.

**Visuals**

One chart image in the top-right corner: a boxed screenshot of a vertical bar chart titled '4th Gen Intel Xeon Scalable Processors', subtitle 'Significant Performance Across Broad Workloads', small header 'Higher is better' and an axis note reading about 'Normalized to 2S 3rd Gen Intel Xeon Scalable platform' (text very small and not fully legible). Bars are grouped under categories Database, HPC, Web, Media, Network and AI, left to right. Bar values are not printed; about 1.0x to 1.3x for the early categories, rising to about 2.5x for the tallest AI bars. Bars are cyan, blue, yellow, pink-lilac and violet in colour blocks, with a red dashed reference line at 1.0x across the plot. Chart background is dark navy with thin horizontal gridlines. No legend is printed. Footer text inside the image reads 'See backup for workloads and configurations. Results may vary.' and the intel XEON logo appears at its lower-left. No photograph or other illustration is present; the page background is a plain gradient.

**Design**

Background is a dark navy diagonal gradient, darkest at top-left (#0A1A33) and lightening to a medium royal blue at bottom-right (#1B4A8A). Title is light ice-blue #D6EEFF. Sub-heading and bullet body text are white #FFFFFF. Accent colour is Intel cyan #00C7FD used in the XEON logo word and the chart subtitle. Typefaces: Intel One Display Light (a clean geometric sans-serif) for body text, Intel One Display Regular for the title, and Arial for bullet glyphs. Title is large, about 8.5% of slide height; sub-heading and body are small, about 2.0% of slide height, with line spacing about 1.9% between lines. Bold white is used for model labels such as 8490H: and 8380: within the bullets. No boxes, lines or shape outlines; chart image has square corners and no border or shadow.

Value labels are too small to read, so all values are estimates. Legend: none. Highlighted points: none. The red baseline is the only reference line. Accelerate with Xeon

**Layout**

Single-column text slide on a full-bleed dark navy background. The title sits top-left at about 7 to 13 percent of the slide height, with a subtitle line below it at 26 percent height, and body bullets in a left-aligned column starting at x 4.3 percent with a hanging bullet indent to x 6.6 percent. A boxed thumbnail chart sits in the top-right corner, and the Intel XEON logo with the tagline 'Accelerate with Xeon' sits bottom-left; there is no slide number or footer.

**Visuals**

One bar chart thumbnail in the top-right corner: a vertical bar chart titled '4th Gen Intel Xeon Scalable Processors', subtitle 'Significant Performance Across Broad Workloads', axis note '2S 4th Gen Intel Xeon Scalable Platform vs. Prior Generation' and 'Higher is better'. Bars are grouped under six category headers (Database, HPC, Web, Media, Network, AI) with a horizontal reference line near the baseline; the bars are grouped in blue, yellow, pink, purple and blue, rising to the tallest bars in the AI group at the right, which reach about the top of the chart area. Individual bar values and the axis tick ranges are too small to read and are not printed; the y-axis label is rotated and unreadable. A small Intel XEON logo and the text 'See backup for workloads and configurations. Results may vary.' appear in the bottom corners of the thumbnail. The title is a raster image of white and pale blue text. No photographs or icons otherwise.

**Design**

Background: Full-bleed dark navy to royal blue gradient, roughly #0B1A3A at top-left to #1C4A9A in the centre and #0A1A38 at bottom-right. Full-bleed dark navy gradient background running from deep navy at the top-left to a slightly brighter royal blue in the centre and back to dark navy at the bottom-right. Title in pale ice-blue #D6EEFF at about 8 percent of slide height, Intel One Display Light style sans-serif, regular weight. Subtitle and body in white #FFFFFF, Intel One Display Light sans-serif, light weight, body at about 1.96 percent of slide height. Hyperlinks and the XEON wordmark in cyan #00C7FD. Bullets are small white dots in Arial. Thin cyan or blue rules: none. No shadows, no rounded corners. The thumbnail chart is a boxed rectangle with a thin light border.

**Layout**

Dark navy full-bleed slide with the title at top left, starting about 4% from the left edge, and a chart image boxed in the top right corner, flush to the top and right edges. Below the title, a subtitle and three bulleted paragraphs are left-aligned in a single text column from about 4.3% to 92% of the width, with a hanging bullet indent at about 4.3% and continuation lines at about 6.6%. The Intel XEON logo and the tagline Accelerate with Xeon sit in the bottom left corner, and there is no page number or footer text.

**Visuals**

Chart image, top right, boxed and not cropped: a screenshot-style bar chart titled 4th Gen Intel Xeon Scalable Processors, subtitled Significant Performance Across Broad Workloads, with the line 2.5-4th Gen Intel Xeon Scalable Platform vs. Prior Generation and the note Higher is better. Bars are grouped under the categories Database, HPC, Web, Media, Network and AI. Bar colours run from cyan through blue to violet, with the bars under AI and the rightmost bars the tallest and most saturated. The Network and AI groups show bars rising to about 1.5 to 2.5 times the prior generation (values estimated, not legible at this size). A red horizontal reference line sits at the 1.0 baseline. The y-axis is labelled Normalized to 2.5-4th Gen Intel Xeon Scalable platform. The bar labels are too small to read reliably. An Intel XEON logo sits at the bottom left of the chart and the footnote See backup for workloads and configurations. Results may vary. appears at the bottom right of the chart. No legend is visible. Background of the chart is dark blue with a faint gradient. Logo: Intel XEON, bottom left of slide, in white and cyan #00C7FD. No other photographs, icons or diagrams are present.

**Design**

Background: Full-bleed dark blue gradient from navy #0B1F3A (top left) to blue #1B4F8A (bottom right). Full-bleed dark blue gradient, deep navy #0B1F3A at the top left shifting to a brighter blue #1B4F8A toward the bottom right. Corner radii none. No shadows, no gradient overlays on the text.

No photographs or charts on the main slide.

**Layout**

Single full-width text column on a dark navy field. The title sits top-left at about 8% to 16% of slide height, left-aligned at x 6.4%, with the title rendered as an image. Three stacked blocks of small body text (heading plus bullets) start at x 6.2% and run down to about 88% of height. Bullet text is indented to x 7.6%. The Intel XEON logo sits bottom-left and the tagline sits beside it. No slide number or footer is visible. Margins are about 6% on the left and about 6% on the right.

**Visuals**

None apart from the Intel XEON logo lockup in the bottom-left corner (white intel wordmark with cyan XEON below) and the title, which is a rendered image of the title text. The body is text only. No charts, tables, photographs or diagrams.

**Design**

Background: Diagonal dark navy to medium blue gradient, from about #0B1B3A at top-left to about #1B4A85 at centre-right. Dark navy to deep blue gradient background running from near-black navy at top-left to medium blue at centre-right. Title in pale ice-blue #DDEFFF, Intel One Display Regular, sans-serif, large (about 7.8% of slide height cap height region). Body text is white #FFFFFF, Intel One Display Regular, sans-serif, about 1.5% of slide height, with bullets in white Arial. Section headings are regular weight and not bold. Accent colour is cyan #00C7FD on the XEON wordmark. Tagline is Intel One Display Light, white. No shapes, rules, borders or shadows. No corner radii.

Dark full-bleed gradient slide with a single-column text layout.
